name: wp-blog-kit
description: Development tools for the Tala Blog theme and Tala SEO plugin: linters and browser tests. The theme and plugin ship as they are, with no build step.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:theme && npm run lint:readme && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:readme: node bin/validate-readme.mjs tala-seo && node bin/validate-readme.mjs tala-ads && node bin/validate-readme.mjs tala-guard
